newsitem.title: USA: Heartland Communications Q4 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Heartland Communications Q4 loss widens.

text.p: Heartland Wireless Communications Inc said on Thursday its fourth-quarter earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) results were a loss of $9.6 million, compared to a loss of $0.4 million for the same period the year before.
The company did not provide figures on net income per share.
Heartland's revenues for the fourth quarter of 1996 were $17.1 million, compared to $6.0 million for the same quarter in 1995.
The company said the fourth quarter results for 1996 included one-time charges totalling $9.1 million, including $5.2 million for bad debt and a reserve for uncollectable accounts receivable.
For full-year 1996, Heartland had an EBITDA loss of $7.7 million compared to a loss of $1.5 million the previous year. Revenues were $56.0 million in 1996, while they were $15.3 million in 1995.
